description: Texte à trous de la vidéo « What is the United Nations? » + compréhension et vocabulaire.

questions.question: The United Nations was ___ after World War II. (indice : créée)
Back then, in ___, 51 countries signed on board. (indice : année)
51 countries signed on board, determined to save succeeding generations from the ___ of war. (indice : fléau)
Today, the UN has ___ Member countries. (indice : nombre)
These countries are called Member ___. (indice : États membres)
When countries sign on to become a Member State, they are ___ to the principles outlined in the Charter. (indice : s'engager)
The Charter sets out the ___ for how the organization works and what it stands for. (indice : règles)
The power of the UN lies in the Member States working together, reaching ___ and holding each other accountable. (indice : accords)
The power of the UN lies in Member States reaching agreements and holding each other ___. (indice : responsables)
The UN has shaped and maintained global peace through actions that no country could ever ___ upon alone. (indice : se lancer dans)
The UN ___ agreements that impact us all and ensures countries follow them. (indice : créer)
It provides emergency aid to people affected by conflict and natural ___. (indice : catastrophes naturelles)
The UN sends ___ to conflict areas to stabilize and support peace efforts. (indice : soldats de la paix)
The UN promotes and protects the rights and ___ of all people. (indice : libertés)
It reduces ___ and inequality and protects the planet. (indice : pauvreté)
It ensures everyone has access to ___, justice, and prosperity. (indice : santé)
The UN is an essential organization for international ___. (indice : collaboration)
Together, we can ___ global challenges. (indice : s'attaquer à)
Together, we can tackle global challenges and ___ to build a more peaceful world. (indice : s'unir)
Together, we can unite to build a more ___ world. (indice : pacifique)
When was the UN created?
choix: 1948, with the Declaration of Human Rights
questions.explication: La Charte a été signée en 1945, après la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

questions.question: How many countries signed the Charter in 1945?
How many Member States does the UN have today?
How many votes does each Member State have in the General Assembly?
choix: a number of votes based on its budget contribution
no vote: only the Security Council votes
a number of votes based on its population
questions.explication: Chaque État membre, grand ou petit, a une voix à l'Assemblée générale.

questions.question: What is the Charter?
choix: a resolution of the Security Council
the document that sets out the rules for how the UN works and what it stands for
the yearly speech of the Secretary-General
the list of UN peacekeeping missions
questions.explication: La Charte fixe les règles de fonctionnement et les valeurs de l'ONU.

questions.question: Where do the Member States meet (each with one vote)?
questions.explication: Les 193 pays se réunissent à l'Assemblée générale.

questions.question: What does « to hold each other accountable » mean?
choix: to make each other answer for their actions and commitments
questions.explication: to hold someone accountable = demander des comptes à quelqu'un.

questions.question: What does « to sign on board » mean here?
choix: to sign a peace treaty with an enemy

questions.question: According to the video, what does the UN do? (plusieurs réponses)
choix: It promotes and protects rights and freedoms
It reduces poverty and inequality and protects the planet
It sends peacekeepers to conflict areas
It has its own permanent army that invades countries
It provides emergency aid to people affected by conflict and natural disasters
It elects the governments of its Member States
It collects taxes directly from citizens
It creates agreements and ensures countries follow them
questions.explication: Créer des accords, apporter une aide d'urgence, envoyer des Casques bleus, protéger les droits et libertés, réduire la pauvreté et les inégalités, protéger la planète.

questions.question: How can citizens contribute to the work of the UN? (plusieurs réponses)
questions.explication: Par le bénévolat, les associations locales, les entreprises…

questions.question: The UN was created to save succeeding generations from…
questions.verso: the scourge of war (le fléau de la guerre) — formule du préambule de la Charte.

questions.question: Résumé : What is the United Nations?
questions.verso: Created in 1945 after WWII by 51 countries; today 193 Member States, one vote each in the General Assembly; rules set out in the Charter. It creates agreements, provides emergency aid, sends peacekeepers, protects rights and freedoms, reduces poverty and inequality, protects the planet.

questions.question: succéder / les générations futures
s'engager à (respecter des principes)
se tenir mutuellement responsables
ce que l'organisation défend (ses valeurs)
l'aide d'urgence
les libertés
les inégalités
le bénévolat
s'unir
pacifique
